output.summary: KEP-1495 proposes adding a new PVC field, DataSourceRef, that accepts volume populator data sources without silently dropping input, deprecating (never removing) the DataSource field, and adding a VolumePopulator CRD plus a volume-data-source-validator controller to report feedback for unregistered sources. The KEP is marked implementable and stage stable.
output.rationale:
The existing DataSource validation uses a whitelist of object types and silently ignores unsupported objects, which cannot scale to out-of-tree populators and cannot be fixed compatibly. The design therefore introduces DataSourceRef, which never ignores input, and moves validation for non-core kinds to an async controller that registers kinds via VolumePopulator CRs. Reviewers questioned the async-versus-sync tradeoff, and the design was revised to keep the in-tree part minimal.</rationale>
<parameter name="outcome_reason">null

alternatives.option: Keep extending the DataSource whitelist with a feature gate per object type
alternatives.why_not: The readme says this approach 'won't scale to generic populators, which will by their nature be too numerous and varied.'

alternatives.option: Change DataSource validation to reject unsupported objects in place
alternatives.why_not: The readme says 'It's not possible to update this behavior in a backwards-compatible way, which forces us to use a different mechanism for populators.'

alternatives.option: Synchronous enforcement via a validating webhook instead of an async controller
alternatives.why_not: Discussion shows the author chose the controller model; a reviewer asked why it changed from webhook to controller and the author said the populator guts live out of tree and the detail was deferred. The sources do not give a full rationale for rejecting the webhook.

evidence.quote: This proposal recommends that we replace the `DataSource` field with a new `DataSourceRef` field with expanded semantics.
The new `DataSourceRef` field will allow objects other than existing data sources (PVC and VolumeSnapshots), and crucially will never ignore inputs.
We will introduce a new CRD to register valid datasource kinds, and individual volume populators will create a CR for each kind of data source that it understands.
The deprecation won't happen until the new field reaches beta or GA. In any case, it will NEVER be removed
